display_name: 非PAMF冻结模型统一推理成本：三种子69配置
description: 复用F0、ManyRx、通用DG和历史ResNet冻结默认头；同GPU、同torch1.11环境、固定合成输入；零新增训练和目标访问。全部识别矩阵完成后才测GPU。
authorization: 既有非PAMF完整对比目标及已固定设计中的统一推理成本；复用冻结三种子，不增加训练，不占用健康任务GPU。

code.commit: publisher records actual Git commit in release_commit.txt/package.json
code.environment: uniform existing SDG-SEI Python3.8 torch1.11 NumPy1.23; no shared install

data.dataset: synthetic zero IQ for cost only; frozen source contracts retained
data.version: 2x256 FP32 resident input, no real/source/target IQ loaded
data.contract_ref: original source contracts checked by the frozen-model loader
data.label_map_ref: original source_contract classes; no labels provided for timing
data.validation_ref: reuse existing validated source contracts; no data construction/revalidation

permissions.claim_scope: specified inference path and runtime; no new accuracy/generalization/in-orbit claim

checkpoint.initialization: load original frozen default head and backbone; no training
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: cost.load_task invokes original parent, suite or legacy strict loader
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: per-row strict contract/provenance/default-head checks at load; future checkpoints not claimed verified now
checkpoint.selection_rule: reuse original source-selected/fixed-final checkpoint; no new selection

execution.gpu_policy: after suite process exits and all186 training/6evaluation closure; select one idle GPU from physical0/1 once; keep same GPU for all69; wait foreign tasks
execution.stop_rule: first technical/contended measurement failure leaves PARTIAL and stops unstarted cost rows; no intervention in other owners; preserve all outputs

metrics_plan.scorer_ref: not applicable; no predictions/truth; synchronized1000 timings per batch and three-seed cost aggregation
